name: io.github.docling-project/docling-rs
title: docling.rs
description: Documents to Markdown for agents: PDF layout, tables and OCR, Office, HTML, scans. docling in Rust.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: Directory the server may read documents from; local paths and file: URIs outside it are refused. Repeatable.

packageArguments.name: --allow-url-fetch
packageArguments.description: Also convert http(s) URLs (private and loopback addresses stay blocked).

environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_RS_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where `docling-rs-mcp --download-models` puts the PDF/image models and the server finds them (default ~/.cache/docling.rs).

environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_RS_OCR_LANG
environmentVariables.description: OCR language for scans: en (default), ch, or a BCP-47 tag.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: The documents directory, mounted at /data — the image's working directory and the server's root.

documents_dir.description: Directory on the host with the documents to convert
